title: RE: LI-2026-0142 Clinic Note for IBC — Three Replies

fields.cc: Joel Whitcomb (Research Compliance); Marcus Tran (Biosafety Officer); Dr. Mbeki (Occupational Health Clinic)
fields.subject: RE: FW: LI-2026-0142 clinic note for IBC
fields.body:
Hi,

Let's not overreact. A tube broke and she's fine. Log it as an internal incident and we'll discuss it at the meeting in two weeks. The program officer's note below says the same thing, and I'd rather not start an NIH file over a centrifuge.

Dan

-----Original Message-----
From: Joel Whitcomb <research.compliance@hsu.example>
Sent: Tuesday, October 13, 2026 11:36 AM
To: Prof. Dennis Okafor
Cc: Marcus Tran; Dr. Mbeki; IBC Members
Subject: FW: LI-2026-0142 clinic note for IBC

For your file. This came in from the program officer on the federal health agency award that supports the bacterial genetics project. I called him at 11:20 to let him know an incident had happened.

> From: Dr. Karen Whitlow <k.whitlow@fedsponsor.example>
> Sent: Tuesday, October 13, 2026 11:33 AM
> Subject: RE: HSU incident heads-up
>
> Off the cuff, this sounds like an equipment problem with no infection. I really don't think it needs an NIH report. Happy to chat.
> Karen

-----Original Message-----
From: Dr. Mbeki <ohclinic@hsu.example>
Sent: Tuesday, October 13, 2026 11:31 AM
To: Prof. Dennis Okafor
Cc: Marcus Tran; Joel Whitcomb
Subject: LI-2026-0142 clinic note for IBC

Prof. Dennis Okafor,

Signed visit note attached.

I still need the PI's written description of the event before I can close my note.

Dr. Mbeki
Occupational Health Clinic
fields.signature:
Daniel Okafor, PhD
Professor, Department of Biology
Member, Institutional Biosafety Committee
Halvorsen State University | Marlow Falls, Iowa

instructorNote: This inject tests whether the IBC chair classifies the event, rather than the program officer or a single committee member. Watch for the chair to use the clinic's exposure wording to set the event as NIH-reportable, to give NIH OSP an early phone or e-mail notice, and to record the program officer's view as informal advice. Also watch for the RC to correct the sponsor row on the clock board to the Iowa Corn Growers Board's 72-hour term (due 16 Oct 09:02) and to write down who notifies whom, how and when. The thread is dated 13 Oct 2026 to match the earlier injects, so if anyone asks about dates, use 13 Oct.
